topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Well, I hear tell that old Bill's been shifted over to the weavers. Can you imagine such a thing? Bill, who's been with the mill all these years. They say the master's got his reasons, but the turning of the earth and the changing of the seasons, they seem more steady than the whims of those who sit in high chairs. I've got to go see old Bill, maybe offer him a bit of my apple cider. It's a long journey from one end of the manor to the other, but if anything can bring comfort in these strange times, it's a good friend and a warm drink. May the saints watch over him in this new path he's treading.
